1.speaker: the-lord
1.quote: “Go, marry a promiscuous woman and have children with her, for like an adulterous wife this land is guilty of unfaithfulness to the Lord.”

1.speaker: the-lord
1.quote: Call him Jezreel, because I will soon punish the house of Jehu for the massacre at Jezreel, and I will put an end to the kingdom of Israel.

1.speaker: the-lord
1.quote: In that day I will break Israel`s bow in the Valley of Jezreel.

1.speaker: the-lord
1.quote: “Call her Lo-Ruhamah (which means “not loved”), for I will no longer show love to Israel, that I should at all forgive them.

1.speaker: the-lord
1.quote: Yet I will show love to Judah; and I will save them—not by bow, sword or battle, or by horses and horsemen, but I, the Lord their God, will save them.

1.speaker: the-lord
1.quote: “Call him Lo-Ammi (which means “not my people”), for you are not my people, and I am not your God.

1.speaker: the-lord
1.quote: “Yet the Israelites will be like the sand on the seashore, which cannot be measured or counted. In the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,` they will be called ‘children of the living God.`

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: “Say of your brothers, ‘My people,` and of your sisters, ‘My loved one.`

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: “Rebuke your mother, rebuke her, for she is not my wife, and I am not her husband. Let her remove the adulterous look from her face and the unfaithfulness from between her breasts.

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: Otherwise I will strip her naked and make her as bare as on the day she was born; I will make her like a desert, turn her into a parched land, and slay her with thirst.

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: I will not show my love to her children, because they are the children of adultery.

2.speaker: israel
2.quote: ‘I will go after my lovers, who give me my food and my water, my wool and my linen, my olive oil and my drink.`

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: Therefore I will block her path with thornbushes; I will wall her in so that she cannot find her way.

2.speaker: israel
2.quote: ‘I will go back to my husband as at first, for then I was better off than now.`

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: She has not acknowledged that I was the one who gave her the grain, the new wine and oil, who lavished on her the silver and gold— which they used for Baal.

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: “Therefore I will take away my grain when it ripens, and my new wine when it is ready. I will take back my wool and my linen, intended to cover her naked body.

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: So now I will expose her lewdness before the eyes of her lovers; no one will take her out of my hands.

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: I will stop all her celebrations: her yearly festivals, her New Moons, her Sabbath days—all her appointed festivals.

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: I will ruin her vines and her fig trees, which she said were her pay from her lovers; I will make them a thicket, and wild animals will devour them.

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: I will punish her for the days she burned incense to the Baals; she decked herself with rings and jewelry, and went after her lovers, but me she forgot,”

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: “Therefore I am now going to allure her; I will lead her into the wilderness and speak tenderly to her.

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: There I will give her back her vineyards, and will make the Valley of Achor a door of hope. There she will respond as in the days of her youth, as in the day she came up out of Egypt.

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: “In that day,”

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: “you will call me ‘my husband`; you will no longer call me ‘my master.`

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: I will remove the names of the Baals from her lips; no longer will their names be invoked.

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: In that day I will make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field, the birds in the sky and the creatures that move along the ground. Bow and sword and battle I will abolish from the land, so that all may lie down in safety.

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: I will betroth you to me forever; I will betroth you in righteousness and justice, in love and compassion.

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: I will betroth you in faithfulness, and you will acknowledge the Lord.

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: “In that day I will respond,”

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: “I will respond to the skies, and they will respond to the earth;

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: and the earth will respond to the grain, the new wine and the olive oil, and they will respond to Jezreel.

2.speaker: the-lord
2.quote: I will plant her for myself in the land; I will show my love to the one I called ‘Not my loved one.` I will say to those called ‘Not my people,` ‘You are my people`; and they will say, ‘You are my God.`”

3.speaker: the-lord
3.quote: “Go, show your love to your wife again, though she is loved by another man and is an adulteress. Love her as the Lord loves the Israelites, though they turn to other gods and love the sacred raisin cakes.”

3.speaker: hosea
3.quote: “You are to live with me many days; you must not be a prostitute or be intimate with any man, and I will behave the same way toward you.”

4.speaker: the-lord
4.quote: There is no faithfulness, no love, no acknowledgment of God in the land.

4.speaker: the-lord
4.quote: But let no one bring a charge, let no one accuse another, for your people are like those who bring charges against a priest.

4.speaker: the-lord
4.quote: Because you have rejected knowledge, I also reject you as my priests; because you have ignored the law of your God, I also will ignore your children.

4.speaker: the-lord
4.quote: “Though you, Israel, commit adultery, do not let Judah become guilty. “Do not go to Gilgal; do not go up to Beth Aven. And do not swear, ‘As surely as the Lord lives!`

5.speaker: the-lord
5.quote: Hear this, you priests! Pay attention, you Israelites! Listen, royal house! This judgment is against you: You have been a snare at Mizpah, a net spread out on Tabor.

5.speaker: the-lord
5.quote: Sound the trumpet in Gibeah, the horn in Ramah. Raise the battle cry in Beth Aven; lead on, Benjamin.

5.speaker: the-lord
5.quote: For I will be like a lion to Ephraim, like a great lion to Judah. I will tear them to pieces and go away; I will carry them off, with no one to rescue them.

5.speaker: the-lord
5.quote: Then I will return to my lair until they have borne their guilt and seek my face— in their misery they will earnestly seek me.

6.speaker: the-people
6.quote: Come, let us return to the Lord. He has torn us to pieces but he will heal us; he has injured us but he will bind up our wounds.

6.speaker: the-people
6.quote: After two days he will revive us; on the third day he will restore us, that we may live in his presence.

6.speaker: the-people
6.quote: Let us acknowledge the Lord; let us press on to acknowledge him. As surely as the sun rises, he will appear; he will come to us like the winter rains, like the spring rains that water the earth.

6.speaker: the-lord
6.quote: What can I do with you, Ephraim? What can I do with you, Judah? Your love is like the morning mist, like the early dew that disappears.

6.speaker: the-lord
6.quote: For I desire mercy, not sacrifice, and acknowledgment of God rather than burnt offerings.

7.speaker: the-lord
7.quote: Woe to them, because they have strayed from me! Destruction to them, because they have rebelled against me! I long to redeem them but they speak about me falsely.

8.speaker: the-lord
8.quote: Put the trumpet to your lips! An eagle is over the house of the Lord because the people have broken my covenant and rebelled against my law.

8.speaker: the-lord
8.quote: Samaria, throw out your calf-idol! My anger burns against them. How long will they be incapable of purity?

9.speaker: the-lord
9.quote: The days of punishment are coming, the days of reckoning are at hand. Let Israel know this.

9.speaker: the-lord
9.quote: When I found Israel, it was like finding grapes in the desert; when I saw your ancestors, it was like seeing the early fruit on the fig tree.

9.speaker: the-lord
9.quote: Because of all their wickedness in Gilgal, I hated them there. Because of their sinful deeds, I will drive them out of my house. I will no longer love them; all their leaders are rebellious.

10.speaker: israel
10.quote: “We have no king because we did not revere the Lord. But even if we had a king, what could he do for us?”

10.speaker: israel
10.quote: “Cover us!” and to the hills, “Fall on us!”

10.speaker: the-lord
10.quote: Sow righteousness for yourselves, reap the fruit of unfailing love, and break up your unplowed ground; for it is time to seek the Lord, until he comes and showers his righteousness on you.

11.speaker: the-lord
11.quote: When Israel was a child, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called my son.

11.speaker: the-lord
11.quote: How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I treat you like Admah? How can I make you like Zeboyim? My heart is changed within me; all my compassion is aroused.

11.speaker: the-lord
11.quote: I will not carry out my fierce anger, nor will I devastate Ephraim again. For I am God, and not a man— the Holy One among you. I will not come against their cities.

12.speaker: the-lord
12.quote: But you must return to your God; maintain love and justice, and wait for your God always.

12.speaker: israel
12.quote: “I am very rich; I have become wealthy. With all my wealth they will not find in me any iniquity or sin.”

12.speaker: the-lord
12.quote: I have been the Lord your God ever since you came out of Egypt; I will make you live in tents again, as in the days of your appointed festivals.

13.speaker: the-lord
13.quote: But I have been the Lord your God ever since you came out of Egypt. You shall acknowledge no God but me, no Savior except me.

13.speaker: the-lord
13.quote: You are destroyed, Israel, because you are against me, against your helper.

13.speaker: the-lord
13.quote: Where is your king, that he may save you? Where are your rulers in all your towns, of whom you said, ‘Give me a king and princes`?

13.speaker: the-lord
13.quote: I will deliver this people from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death. Where, O death, are your plagues? Where, O grave, is your destruction?

14.speaker: hosea
14.quote: Return, Israel, to the Lord your God. Your sins have been your downfall!

14.speaker: hosea
14.quote: Take words with you and return to the Lord. Say to him: “Forgive all our sins and receive us graciously, that we may offer the fruit of our lips.

14.speaker: the-people
14.quote: Assyria cannot save us; we will not mount warhorses. We will never again say ‘Our gods` to what our own hands have made, for in you the fatherless find compassion.”

14.speaker: the-lord
14.quote: I will heal their waywardness and love them freely, for my anger has turned away from them.

14.speaker: the-lord
14.quote: I will be like the dew to Israel; he will blossom like a lily. Like a cedar of Lebanon he will send down his roots;

14.speaker: the-lord
14.quote: Ephraim, what more have I to do with idols? I will answer him and care for him. I am like a flourishing juniper; your fruitfulness comes from me.
